invariants: job identity, owner, plan, submit key, state, attempt, spool and event order remain exact
legacy PascalCase job states remain readable
step executions are derived once from the immutable plan without executing effects
dataset resolution and temporary-dataset maps default empty without resolving or allocating data
legacy jobs default to batch, external submission and LOCAL unowned routing without moving work
typed program registrations are derived once from the frozen common catalog without executing a step
cancellation, purge intent and effect sequence default empty without claiming an outcome
selected or running jobs recover to queued unless the bounded attempt limit is exhausted
a CAS conflict publishes no partial migrated projection
